T050-C01.survey_scope_note: Q9=191 remains a lower bound, not a solved optimum. The sampled 131-class census is not an optimality proof. The current paper v3, author-repository snapshot, and Leaps in Bounds status entry were checked on 2026-11-06.

analytic_upper_bound.derivation: For k path vertices, the induced graph has k-1 edges. Its outgoing edges are 9k-2(k-1)=7k+2, at most 9(512-k). Thus16k<=4606, k<=287 and path edges<=286.
analytic_upper_bound.scope: Independent conservative counting bound; no claim that this is the best published upper bound.
